description: This file defines the Git::SVN::Migration package, containing functions for migrating and managing SVN layout versions within a Git repository, including layout migration routines and configuration adjustments.

methods.name: migrate_from_v0
methods.description: Migrates repository layout from version 0 to newer formats by renaming refs based on info from the environment and repository state.

methods.name: migrate_from_v1
methods.description: Migrates repository layout from version 1 by copying SVN info and reorganizing refs.

methods.name: read_old_urls
methods.description: Recursively reads old URL mappings from SVN info directories.

methods.name: migrate_from_v2
methods.description: Migrates repository layout from version 2 by initializing SVN remotes based on stored URL info.

methods.name: minimize_connections
methods.description: Optimizes SVN remote connections by consolidating URLs and updating config accordingly.

methods.name: migration_check
methods.description: Performs sequential migration checks from v0, v1, v2 layouts and optionally minimizes connections.
